ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; approximately 0.05:0.95 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly solid low-intensity distribution (dark grey/black); distinct high-intensity pixel clusters (white) are isolated at the distal lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex fitted curve extending from the peduncle junction to the lateral distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, large-scale irregular notch or tissue deficit on the trailing edge of the right lobe, distinct from the primary serration pattern.
